source_scope: These are consequences of transcription differences only; no mathematical assertion is checked by this file. Exact complete readings remain in the selected-source contract.

mathematical_consequence_by_locus.L003: The opening family label retains the ordered readings mathcal E, mathscr E and epsilon; H gives omega with epsilon in a note.
mathematical_consequence_by_locus.S01: The opening Sigma retains both a live lower alpha and a live upper alpha; H supplies only the upper alpha.
mathematical_consequence_by_locus.S03: The first raised Sigma retains a live lower alpha beneath its live upper alpha; H N02 omits the lower alpha.
mathematical_consequence_by_locus.S04: The second raised Sigma preserves the complete cancelled/live lower-alpha alternatives with their local head-run states; H omits the lower component.
mathematical_consequence_by_locus.S05: The third raised Sigma preserves all24 complete states of the lower component, overwritten upper component, live upper alpha, ring and head-run allocation. The cancellation scopes remain local to their stated components.
mathematical_consequence_by_locus.S07: The Sigma following si les retains cancelled/live lower-alpha readings beneath the live upper alpha; H omits that lower component.
mathematical_consequence_by_locus.S08: The Sigma in the struck clause retains its lower alpha and the upper alpha with0/circle/o alternatives. H omits the lower alpha; the whole glyph remains within the deletion.
mathematical_consequence_by_locus.L017: The diagram label retains E with lower alpha or a lower-right flourish, each with its own upper-run allocation. H gives E without the lower qualification.
mathematical_consequence_by_locus.L018: The diagram relation retains superset-equal first and superset with the extra lower retrace second; both witnesses give superset alone.
mathematical_consequence_by_locus.L021: The manuscript wording retained here includes ne peut and ouvert et fermé. H instead transcribes une partie à la fois ouverte et fermée with an adjacent uncertain si. The existing root source preserves the full local sequence and the separately qualified following marks.
mathematical_consequence_by_locus.S14: The last car Sigma retains18 complete states combining the first raised component minus/alpha/minus-alpha, the ring0/circle/o and the local head allocation. H gives alpha,0. Its following low comma remains separate.
mathematical_consequence_by_locus.L038: The first displayed relation remains qualified as wedge with independent point, cap with detached-foot point, or cap with independent point, in that order; both witnesses print cap alone.
mathematical_consequence_by_locus.L044: The first lower relation retains subset, cancelled-cap-plus-subset and membership as complete ordered alternatives; the ink does not yield one firm relation.
mathematical_consequence_by_locus.L045: The cancelled pair after the first lower right Sigma is read as ne emptyset; the cancellation is retained and C’s glyph uncertainty is resolved.
